result.summary: The page is visually coherent. The right-edge clipping of the category chips and restaurant carousel, and the partially visible card at the bottom, are expected scroll behavior and not defects. One content inconsistency was found.

issues.description: The restaurant heading reads 'Tokumaru Ramer', which appears to be a misspelling and is inconsistent with the 'Ramen' cuisine label shown directly beneath it.
issues.suggestion: Correct the restaurant name to 'Tokumaru Ramen' so it matches the cuisine label and intended branding.
